projects.name: KerjayaKu (Finalist)
projects.quote: Turn skill gaps into a journey
projects.synopsis: Helping Malaysian students turn career interests and skill gaps into an actionable learning journey inside a 3D world.
projects.intro: KerjayaKu connects career exploration, job-market examples and personalised learning in an interactive 3D environment. Students build a skills profile, choose or describe a target role, and receive AI-assisted learning paths, resources and practical tasks to close their skill gaps.
features: Compare a CV or skills profile with career requirements
Break skill gaps into milestones, tasks and learning resources
Explore career rankings, monthly demand and skill mentions
Learning activity advances progress and a career companion
Ask an AI mentor questions and sync progress through Telegram

projects.name: ItFitS
projects.quote: Check the fit before you buy
projects.synopsis: A mobile app for checking clothing fit, comparing sizes and exploring AI try-on through one connected workflow.
projects.intro: Built with React Native, Expo and TypeScript, ItFitS connects to a FastAPI backend. With Gemini API access configured, it can generate AI try-on images. When the backend is offline, it falls back to on-device size-table calculations. A mock storefront links product pages directly to the try-on flow.
features: FIT, COMPARE, TRY ON, BODY and REVIEW
Generate try-on images with a configured Gemini API
Use on-device size tables when the backend is unavailable
Open the try-on flow directly from a mock product page
Web frontend and backend deployment on Vercel

projects.name: MetriX AI (1st Runner up)
projects.pitch: Mine smarter. Verify better. Recover more.
projects.quote: Mine smarter. Verify better. Recover more.
projects.synopsis: A mining product prototype connecting equipment and route optimisation, sampling support and secondary resource value assessment.
projects.intro: MetriX AI presents MineFit AI, QualityGuard AI and CircularMine AI through a product website and a six-wheel-legged sampling rover concept. The interactive 3D model supports orbit, driving, sampling and exploded views. English and Chinese product pages explain the proposed workflows. Current deliverables focus on product concepts, web demonstrations and the rover prototype.
features: Present equipment and route optimisation concepts
Explore sampling support and quality verification workflows
Present secondary resource value assessment concepts
Interactive wheel-legged rover with drive, sample and exploded views
English and Chinese product and technology presentations

projects.name: SecEff (Finalist)
projects.pitch: Security, cost and carbon in one view
projects.quote: One decision layer for the cloud
projects.synopsis: A cloud governance demo combining security, resource efficiency and carbon intelligence for construction technology teams.
projects.intro: SecEff analyses a simulated cloud asset dataset through four connected engines: security auditing, resource efficiency, carbon estimation and AI recommendations. It brings findings into one decision layer to help teams identify which cloud resources and actions deserve attention first.
features: Identify public access, risky ports, encryption gaps and attack paths
Find idle, orphaned and over-provisioned resources
Estimate monthly emissions using energy use and regional carbon intensity
Recommend next steps to reduce risk, cost and carbon emissions
Demonstration built around a simulated cloud asset dataset

projects.name: EmptyClass
projects.pitch: See every empty seat on campus
projects.quote: See every empty seat on campus
projects.synopsis: Find available seats across campus by counting occupancy in classrooms, libraries and study spaces from camera footage.
projects.intro: The React and Vite prototype includes a live demo, floor plans and an animated explanation of the workflow. Recorded video stands in for live CCTV; YOLO detects people, while OpenCV maps detections to seat zones. The proposed backend aggregates counts for WebSocket updates, retaining counts rather than footage.
features: Use recorded video in place of a live CCTV feed
Detect people with YOLOv8n without extracting facial features
Map detections to seat regions with OpenCV
Retain occupancy counts rather than storing footage
Explore floor plans and the live demonstration interface

projects.name: EcoLink
projects.quote: Every match makes the next one better
projects.synopsis: An AI ecosystem relationship engine for Cradle that turns mentor and company matching into an accumulating, repeatable workflow.
projects.intro: EcoLink treats ecosystem relationships as reusable data instead of restarting mentor matching and company allocation from scratch. Gemini scores potential matches and explains its reasoning. Collaboration outcomes feed into future recommendations, with human approval required before relationships are established.
features: Gemini provides match scores, explanations and confidence levels
Feed collaboration outcomes back into future matching decisions
Surface confidence and bias signals with human approval
Endpoints for profile extraction, matching, recommendations and feedback
FastAPI backend, application structure, scoring and AI modules

projects.name: EnerVision AI
projects.pitch: Energy that knows who is home
projects.quote: Energy that knows who is home
projects.synopsis: A smart-home energy prototype using occupancy, brightness and sleep-state estimates to guide lighting, air conditioning and power controls.
projects.intro: Python simulations cover occupancy detection, brightness-aware lighting, non-invasive sleep estimation and automation rules, with energy logs and monthly reports. An interactive dollhouse-style web prototype adapts a home model to household inputs. An OpenCV webcam mode detects absence and starts an inactivity countdown.
features: Estimate occupancy, brightness and sleep state
Apply automation rules to lights, air conditioning, fans and smart plugs
Energy logging, adaptive behaviour and monthly reporting
Explore an interactive dollhouse-style web prototype
Start a five-minute countdown when OpenCV detects no occupants

projects.name: Daily News
projects.synopsis: Automatically prepare a Chinese-language summary of the previous day's important news at 7 a.m.
projects.intro: A daily 07:00 scheduler fetches and archives RSS news, deduplicates and categorises it locally, then uses OpenAI to produce structured Chinese-language summaries. Results can be exported as Markdown, CSV and JSON, with optional delivery to Notion, Telegram or email.
features: Fetch and archive original news from RSS feeds
Use OpenAI to generate structured Chinese-language summaries
Optional delivery to Notion, Telegram or email

projects.name: Peer Tutoring
projects.synopsis: A peer tutoring platform prototype connecting students and tutors in support of SDG 4: Quality Education.
projects.intro: The platform matches students with tutors by subject, availability and preferences. Tutors can create profiles and list their expertise; students can search, review profiles and book sessions. This Principles of Software Engineering team project includes design, planning, testing and final deliverables.
features: Match by subject, availability and learning preferences
Tutors create profiles and list their areas of expertise
Students search tutors, review profiles and book sessions
Design, planning, testing and final project delivery
